ja: 恐竜の骨格・外皮をひとつひとつ確かめながら自分で組み立て、自分の手で恐竜を“知りつくす”ブランド『プラノサウルス』から、史上最大級の肉食恐竜「スピノサウルス」が登場！
• 「骨格ビルド」で恐竜の内部構造から知ることができる。
• 「恐竜ビルド」で骨格の上から外皮パーツを取り付けるプラモデルならではの仕様でスピノサウルスの姿を復元。
• ニッパー等の道具や接着剤が必要ないから簡単に組み立てられる。
• パーツの選択で最新の学説に基づいた四足歩行状態を再現可能。
• 台座を使用することで泳ぐ姿のままディスプレイが可能。
• 特徴的な背中の帆の厚みや前肢の鋭いカギヅメなど細かなディテールも表現。
• 水上の様子を探るのに役立ったと考えられる眼窩の位置や、水圧から臓器を守る腹骨もしっかりと再現。
• 口の開閉や舌、前肢、後肢、首など各所が可動し、好みのポージングでディスプレイが可能。
en: The largest carnivorous dinosaur in history, Spinosaurus, is now available from Planosaurus, a brand that allows you to assemble and get to know dinosaurs by yourself while checking each dinosaur's skeleton and skin one by one!
• "Skeleton Build" allows you to learn about the internal structure of dinosaurs.
• "Dinosaur Build" allows you to restore the appearance of Spinosaurus by attaching the skin parts to the top of the skeleton, which is unique to plastic models.
• Easy to assemble as there is no need for tools such as nippers or adhesives.
• By selecting parts, it is possible to reproduce a quadrupedal walking state based on the latest theory.
• By using a pedestal, it is possible to display it as it swims.
• Fine details such as the characteristic thickness of the sail on the back and the sharp claws on the forelimbs are also expressed.

• The position of the eye sockets, which are thought to have been useful for exploring conditions above water, and the abdominal bone that protects organs from water pressure are also faithfully recreated.
• Various parts such as opening and closing the mouth, tongue, front legs, hind legs, and neck can be moved, allowing you to display it in your favorite pose.
